context_requirements: Hepatocyte-specific bile acid and bile salt export machinery (e.g., NTCP/SLC10A1, BSEP/ABCB11, MRP2/ABCC2) that is not represented among the 978 landmark genes
Functional enterohepatic bile-acid transport and FXR (NR1H4) signalling, largely absent or non-functional in the nine immortalised lines
A choleretic drug target expressed in the assayed lineage; none of the nine lines is a primary hepatocyte or biliary epithelial model
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Induction of a coherent bile-acid/FXR target signature (e.g., NR0B2, ABCB11, SLC10A1) in HEPG2 or another line
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is not explained by vehicle or general cytotoxicity
